newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs seen hovering near 124.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs seen hovering near 124.00.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: INJECTION OF 100 BLN YEN -------------VIEWS FROM THE MARKET - JUNE 2 ------------------
*Key June 10-year JGB futures expected to hover near 124.00 on Monday, as market searches for fresh incentives.
*But if June rises above 124.20, it may next make a try for 124.72, said a trader at a trust bank's securities unit.
*One key for market will be whether investors start buying cash JGBs actively, a trust bank trader said.
